## Version Requirements {#version-requirements}

Mongoose now requires Node.js >= 14.0.0 and MongoDB Node Driver >= 5.0.0.

See [the MongoDB Node Driver migration guide](https://github.com/mongodb/node-mongodb-native/blob/main/etc/notes/CHANGES_5.0.0.md) for detailed info.

Mark it contradicted only when the source gives an incompatible value, version, limit, name, list or rule for that same thing in the same scope. An example value in a code sample that overrides a default does not contradict the default.
